name: dev-core
description: Cross-cutting engineering-discipline skills, independent of framework or stack — each a persona: drafter (plan → scope-tight work order for a headless agent), detective (debug discipline), inspector (intent-validation diff review), archivist (incident post-mortem), scout (reconnaissance on fresh code: connections, both sides of a seam, sightings), herald (what changed on screen between two tags, proven in the diff, for the people who test it). The stack-agnostic tier of claude-kit.
